welcomeMessage: Hi! I'm Nova, ask me anything about BrightBrew Coffee.
businessInfo:
BrightBrew Coffee is a specialty coffee subscription service, sourcing beans directly from small farms in Colombia, Ethiopia, and Guatemala and roasting them fresh within days of your order.

Plans: Starter ($16/month, one 12oz bag every 2 weeks, whole bean or ground), Origin Trio ($42/month, one bag each from Colombia, Ethiopia, and Guatemala), and Gift a Bag ($18 one-time, a single bag with a welcome card, no subscription needed). You can pause, skip, switch plans, or cancel your subscription anytime from Account > Subscription, no fees, effective end of the current billing cycle.

Shipping: free on every US order, no minimum, 3-5 business days standard delivery. We don't ship internationally yet -- it's on our roadmap.

Returns: 100% satisfaction guarantee on your first bag -- contact support within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Damaged or wrong orders get a free replacement or refund, just include your order number.

Gear: pour-over kits ($35, dripper + filters + starter guide), French presses ($28, 34oz borosilicate glass with stainless mesh), and burr grinders ($60-120, 15 grind settings).

Support: email support@brightbrew.example (reply within one business day) or use the live chat -- hours are Monday-Friday 9am-6pm ET, messages outside those hours get a reply the next business day.

faqs.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
faqs.answer: Go to Account > Subscription > Cancel. It takes effect at the end of your current billing cycle and there are no cancellation fees.

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
faqs.answer: Currently we only ship within the United States, but international shipping is on our roadmap.

faqs.question: What if I don't like the coffee?
faqs.answer: We offer a 100% satisfaction guarantee on your first bag. Contact support@brightbrew.example within 30 days for a full refund.

faqs.question: Can I send coffee as a gift?
faqs.answer: Yes! The Gift a Bag plan is a single 12oz bag plus a welcome card for $18, one-time, no subscription required.

faqs.question: How do I contact support?
faqs.answer: Email support@brightbrew.example or chat with us right here -- Mon-Fri 9am-6pm ET, replies within one business day.
